messages:
Maya R: FYI ~6k unacked batches in accounting-shim since 03:10 UTC; invoice-preview spike for some tenants. Anyone on this?

Jon H: saw it. correlated with far-edge shard that rolled sampler-v2 at 00:45.

Sasha: any shim lease/ack changes in that rollout?

Lee: we reverted fast-ack but kept the concat-reassembly tweak. suspect reassembly latency + redis lock TTL mismatch.

Maya R: logs: 
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z accounting-shim WARN lease expired batch=shard-42/seq=98765
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z accounting-shim INFO requeueing batch=shard-42/seq=98765 attempts=4
2026-02-18T03:12:05Z aggregator ERROR duplicate-insert tenant=acme-co batch=98765

Priya: duplicate batch ids on dedupe path means we requeued while previous commit still finishing -> TTL too short.

Jon H: current redis lock TTL=3s, reassembly can hit ~7-8s under load. Immediate mitigation: increase TTL.

Sasha: I'll push hotfix to set TTL=15s and add metrics: histogram reassembly_ms and counter lease_expired_total (shard label).

Maya R: notify support to pause invoice-preview for affected tenants while we validate.

deploy-bot: starting deploy accounting-shim/lease-ttl-hotfix -> aws/ecs/us-west-2 (canary: shard-42)

Lee: medium term we should stream partials to aggregator with idempotency keys instead of whole-batch requeues. Also add integration test for out-of-order partials (sampler-v2 changed ordering).

Sasha: tracing shows fetch-remainder RPC sometimes >8s; attaching trace ids to ticket.

support-bot: ticket PENDING-3421 created (tenants: acme-co, beta-svc, test-tenant-7).

deploy-bot: canary succeeded on shard-42; TTL updated to 15s (rollout 1/5 shards). lease_expired_total dropped on canary.

Jon H: schedule ramp to remaining shards over 2h, monitor duplicate-insert rate and invoice preview delta.

Priya: I'll add Console card under Billing/Metering and author runbook to pause invoice-preview.

Lee: will open PR for idempotency keys + reassembly integration tests.

Maya R: oncall playbook: if invoice-preview > baseline+25% for >10m, revert sampler-v2 on flagged shards. Will post incident summary in #incidents when stable.

Sasha: adding dashboard panels p50/p95/p99 for reassembly_ms and a panel showing p95 vs lease TTL for rollouts.

Maya R: thanks all :thumbsup:
